body:
My experience was decided upon once I read other stories on this site. My mom has a prescription of this medicine and I am sick with an upper respiratory infection and am on an antibiotic (azithromycin). I further decided that I was lighter than most of the people who wrote on this site so I orally took 200 mg and snorted 400 mg. Well nothing really happened. That was at 5pm. I waited until 6pm and decided it wasnt working. I now took 800 mg. Orally and wow! Now I am walking like I am drunk and everything has a sort edge to it. Kinda cool. I went outside to smoke a couple of cigarettes and was a little nervous about my fiancé getting home as he is totally against any drugs. He wont even take pain medication when it is prescribed to him which is good for me. I wait inside and try to walk as straight as I can by walking with a shuffle. Once he got home I sat on the couch and nodded off as we were watching tv. I woke up as he was watching something but I have no idea what. I couldnt focus on the tv and I dont even know if what he was seeing was what I was seeing. Then we went to bed. I awoke and I am still fucked up. I am still wobbly on my feet and everything still feels like it is unfocused. Luckily he is still passed out or he would find me writing this. LOL. So it is now 11:42 am and I have been messed up for 17 hours. I dont recommend this drug if you are planning on doing too much, such as going to work, shopping, school, etc. Also it is extremely hard to hide. I love it though and will definitely do it again. I just hope my mom doesnt realize that she is missing an entire bottle of 90 pills.
